schema.description: Request body for creating a Company.

joinCode.description: A unique 6-character code that can be used to join or reference this Company.

referenceId.description: The ID of the Company in your own system. Another Company with the same reference answers 409.

allOf.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. It can contain up to 10 key-value items with a maximum length of 40 for the key and of 400 chars for the value.
allOf.title: Metadata

metadata.description: The fields of the Company, with the limits of the Customer. Two keys that differ only in case are one key, and answer 400.

schema.title: CreateCompanyRequest

Reference.summary: Create a company identified by your own company ID
